query: we're cutting 0.9.0 friday and the 14 fragments sitting in .changes/unreleased are all still written like PR descriptions — dense, full of why-I-did-it-this-way. get them into shape for release notes

our landing page at apps/web/src/pages/index.astro still says we support three databases. we added clickhouse in june and dropped mongo entirely. fix that, and whatever else has rotted while you're in there
readme is a monster, like 900 lines, and honestly i think half of it is wrong now. give it a proper going over before i point anyone at it

the --help output for our cli reads like five different people wrote it. some flag descriptions end in periods, some don't, half of them start with 'the'. make it consistent — clap definitions are in src/cli.rs

support keeps getting tickets from people who hit 'invalid configuration' and have no idea what to change. the error strings in src/errors.rs are useless. rewrite them so someone can actually act on them
we call the same thing a workspace, a project, and a repo depending on which docs page you land on. it's confusing people in support threads. sort it out
Before the Tuesday announcement I'd like a careful pass over the documentation site — the getting-started guide and the configuration reference especially. Accuracy first, then tone.
the rustdoc on our public traits in crates/core/src/lib.rs has gone stale — a couple of methods still document params that got deleted two releases ago. clean it up, it's what shows on docs.rs
wrote docs/migrating-v2.md from memory over the weekend. can you check that every code sample and config key in it actually matches what shipped in v2
changelog for 3.2 reads like release notes for the engineering team rather than our customers. rewrite the entries so a user can tell whether the release affects them
review this PR for me — packages/api/src/handlers/webhook.ts. mainly worried about the retry logic and whether we're dumping the raw payload into logs
need to get the docs into german and japanese. what's the least painful way to wire up i18n in astro starlight without duplicating every mdx file
our changie setup batches everything into one CHANGELOG.md but we're a monorepo now and need one per package. how do i configure that
docs site build is failing on netlify — 'Cannot find module astro:content'. builds fine locally. any ideas
trying to work out our positioning against dagger and earthly. what should we even be claiming as the differentiator
our structured logs are unusable, everything is at info level. go through src/ and set sensible levels — debug for the per-package stuff, warn for the retries
src/scheduler.rs has a 200-line function i cannot follow at all. add comments explaining what the algorithm is actually doing
add a spellcheck step to CI so typos in docs get caught on PRs. cspell probably? needs to ignore code blocks and our product names
write me a commit message for what's staged — there's the exit code change plus the two new doctor checks
we need docs for the new webhooks feature, nothing exists yet. figure out what pages we need and where they slot into the sidebar
